description: The Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme is an initiative of the Department of Education, Government of Bihar, to provide financial assistance to students pursuing higher education. Under the scheme, eligible students can avail education loans of up to ₹4 lakh at concessional interest rates to cover tuition fees, books, laptops, and other educational expenses. The scheme aims to ensure that deserving students are not deprived of higher education due to financial constraints.
objectives: Provide financial assistance to students pursuing higher education.
Ensure that deserving students are not deprived of education due to financial difficulties.
Support students enrolled in technical, professional, polytechnic, and general degree courses.
Promote access to higher education across Bihar.

benefits.title: Education Loan
benefits.description: Eligible students can avail an education loan of up to ₹4,00,000.

benefits.title: Wide Course Coverage
benefits.description: Loans are available for polytechnic, technical, professional, and general education courses.

benefits.title: Educational Expenses
benefits.description: The loan can be used to pay tuition fees, purchase books, laptops, and other educational expenses.

benefits.title: Easy Repayment
benefits.description: Loan repayment begins after completion of the course and once the student secures employment.

benefits.title: Concessional Interest Rate
benefits.description: An interest rate of 1% is applicable for Divyang, transgender, and girl students.

benefits.title: Flexible Recovery
benefits.description: The loan recovery process is flexible as the scheme is backed by the Government of Bihar.

eligibility.title: Residence
eligibility.description: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Bihar.

eligibility.title: Age
eligibility.description: The applicant should be at least 25 years of age.

eligibility.title: Educational Qualification
eligibility.description: The applicant must have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination.

eligibility.title: Admission
eligibility.description: The applicant must have secured admission to an approved educational institution.

eligibility.title: Course Completion
eligibility.description: The applicant should complete the enrolled course.

registration_steps.title: Visit the Portal
registration_steps.description: Visit the Bihar Student Credit Card portal.

registration_steps.title: Fill Registration Details
registration_steps.description: Enter your name, email ID, mobile number, Aadhaar number, verify OTP, and submit the registration form.

registration_steps.title: Receive Login Credentials
registration_steps.description: Receive the username and password via SMS and email after successful registration.

application_steps.title: Login
application_steps.description: Log in using the registered username and password.

application_steps.title: Fill Personal Information
application_steps.description: Complete the Personal Information page and submit it.

application_steps.title: Complete Application
application_steps.description: Fill in the Bihar Student Credit Card application form and submit it.

application_steps.title: Receive Acknowledgement
application_steps.description: A confirmation message and acknowledgement number will be generated.

application_steps.title: Visit DRCC
application_steps.description: Attend the scheduled appointment at the District Registration and Counseling Center (DRCC) with self-attested documents for verification.

application_steps.title: Loan Sanction
application_steps.description: After successful verification and bank approval, collect the Student Credit Card and loan sanction letter from the DRCC.

application_steps.title: Complete Bank Formalities
application_steps.description: Visit the bank, complete documentation, and receive the loan disbursement.

application_steps.title: Track Application
application_steps.description: Applicants can track their application status through the official portal.

documents_required.name: Class X Mark Sheet and Certificate
Class XII Mark Sheet and Certificate
Income Tax Returns
documents_required.remarks: Previous two years' Income Tax Returns, if applicable.

documents_required.name: Proof of Residence
documents_required.remarks: Passport, Driving Licence, Voter ID, or any valid residence proof.

important_notes: The maximum loan amount available under the scheme is ₹4,00,000.
The scheme covers technical, professional, polytechnic, and general degree courses.
Loan repayment starts only after course completion and employment.
Applicants must visit the District Registration and Counseling Center (DRCC) for document verification.
The loan is sanctioned through participating banks after successful verification.

faqs.question: What is the maximum loan amount available?
faqs.answer: Eligible students can avail an education loan of up to ₹4,00,000.

faqs.question: Who can apply for the scheme?
faqs.answer: Permanent residents of Bihar who have passed Class 12 and secured admission to an approved institution can apply.

faqs.question: What is the interest rate for girl students?
faqs.answer: Girl students, Divyang students, and transgender applicants are charged an interest rate of 1%.

faqs.question: When does loan repayment begin?
faqs.answer: Repayment begins after the completion of the course and after the student secures employment.

faqs.question: Can applicants track their application status?
faqs.answer: Yes, applicants can track their application status through the official Bihar Student Credit Card portal.
